name: InsideDM — recover an uncertain operation by its original intent key

nodes.name: Configure recovery
nodes.notes: A missing retained receipt does not prove no side effect happened. Reconcile the original intent; do not switch to a fresh key automatically.

nodes.name: Discover workspace
nodes.notes: Select a Header Auth credential: Authorization = Bearer <business-key>, with operations.read. Use the same credential on both HTTP nodes.

nodes.name: Look up retained operation
nodes.notes: This is an authenticated lookup, despite using POST. No new Idempotency-Key header is needed. It performs no send, publication, cancellation or replay.
